answer: Sybil keys are cheap, so admission scores a residual, not a count. Each applicant posts a refundable bond and a timed work transcript. The coordinator then measures a residual delta: how far that transcript's embedding and inter-token timing sit from the nearest cluster of seated keys. Only residuals above a published cutoff receive a seat. First-epoch nectar stays locked in a glacier vault that thaws only after two later epochs of isolated residuals. Clones collapse into one cluster, so surplus aliases show a near-zero residual, forfeit the bond, and never thaw a payout.
